name: A Very Fairy Tea Party
source:
A Very Fairy Tea Party is about a university student saving a fairy named Rosalie. After getting to know her a bit, Rosalie asks for help setting up a tea party and making some friends. 

[From [url=https://redcakeycake.itch.io/a-very-fairy-tea-party]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《仙女茶会》讲述了一名大学生拯救一位名叫罗莎莉的仙女的故事。在对她有了一些了解后，罗莎莉请求帮助安排一次茶会并结交一些朋友。

[来自[url=https://redcakeycake.itch.io/a-very-fairy-tea-party]Itch.io[/url]]
